text: ポケモンが　いうこと　きくか　どうかは　ひとの　うでまえ　しだい　なんだもの

structure.jp: ポケモンが　いうこと　きくか　どうかは
structure.en: whether a Pokémon does what it's told or not

structure.jp: ひとの　うでまえ　しだい

patterns.name: 〜かどうか
patterns.explanation: かどうか after a verb means 'whether or not'. いうこと　きくか　どうか = 'whether it obeys or not'.

patterns.name: 〜次第だ
patterns.explanation: しだい right after a thing says everything depends on that thing. うでまえ　しだい = 'it depends on skill'.

patterns.name: 〜んだもの
patterns.explanation: んだもの at the end gives a reason in a soft, slightly feminine 'because that's how it is' tone. しだい　なんだもの = 'because, after all, it depends on that'.
